name: Alexei Petrovich, Tsarevich of Russia
contribution: The Tsarevich of Russia, the eldest son of Tsar Peter I and his first wife, Eudoxia Lopukhina.

checks.lead: Alexei Petrovich Romanov (Russian: Алексей Петрович; 28 February 1690 – 26 June 1718), was the Tsarevich of Russia, the eldest son of Tsar Peter I and his first wife, Eudoxia Lopukhina.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
